parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill

mentions.excerpt: Orbis Investments, which owns Nebius, makes the single-name version concrete: more than four gigawatts of capacity by 2031, more than $50 billion of revenue against $2 billion today, $15 billion of non-core holdings and enough value to justify a $70 billion market value.
